notes.title: Ver.1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for playing Nitro Express.
Today, we have updated the game to Ver.1.02.

Ver.1.02
Bug Fixes

Adjusted the timing and content of radio comms.
Fixed a bug where dying in Story: CASE-3 would still allow the story to be progressed.
Fixed a bug and processing issue that occurred upon arriving at the deepest level in MISSION 20.
Various miscellaneous fixes.

We hope you'll continue to enjoy Nitro Express!

notes.title: Ver.1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for playing Nitro Express.
Today, we have updated the game to Ver.1.01.

Ver.1.01
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where pressing the F8 key in-game would reset the game's data.
Fixed a bug in "Story: CASE-08" where a barrier that should be deactivated after certain dialogue remains active if the player skips the dialogue, making the following fight impossible.
Various miscellaneous fixes.

We hope you'll continue to enjoy Nitro Express!

notes.title: Nitro Express to Release in 2025!
notes.notes:
PLAYISM will be publishing Nitro Express, a 2D side-view gun action game by Grayfax Software, coming to Steam in 2025!

We've also prepared a new trailer that showcases the game's characteristic cute pixel-art girls shooting assault weapons with 360° free aiming in the streets of Japan!

https://youtu.be/KACCdBrHNHQ


Welcome to Nitro City, Tokyo Special Administrative Region! The metropolis of Tokyo is a bit different from what we know, but the streets are just as nostalgic, or, depending on where you're from, they're just as good as the place you've always wanted to visit.

Please wishlist the game and look forward to more news.
